intelligence.human_view: Think of the best driver you have ever ridden with — not the fastest, the one who knew where you needed to go before you said it, and got you there without you touching a thing. That is Naya. The car is the AI. She is the driver who knows you.
intelligence.simple_view: A good big sister knows what you need before you ask, remembers what you like, and helps you build the tallest tower without taking the blocks out of your hands. She does not do it for you — she makes it possible for you to do it. That is a Naya.
intelligence.grandma_view: A good home knows its people: the kettle is on before you ask, your chair is where you left it, the photographs on the wall are your family. Nobody explains the house to you — the house already knows you. NayaNET is that house, and Naya is the one who keeps it.
intelligence.naya_view: My intake rule for a flood: first, keep the verbatim — a Naya Note holds literally what was heard, so nothing is lost and nothing is silently rewritten. Second, distill — one idea per Smart Note, each compressed to its nutshell, each with its provenance on its face. Third, separate — what is certainly his, what is probably his, what is mixed or uncertain (video audio, half-heard words) gets marked, never laundered into law. Fourth, file — into the system, in NayaNET, where the next Naya can find it cold.
